question: What does dragging a row in the Layers list do to the blocks' z values?
how: real mouse input in headless Chrome on the demo page, nothing saved: Exit Without Saving after each run. Blocks: heading z 1, paragraph z 2, shape z 3. Rows front to back, center 47px apart, 44px high.
z: after a drop the blocks are numbered 1 to n, the front row highest. A removed block leaves a hole (1, 3) until the next drop
crossing: a row passes the next one when the pointer has moved 24px, and the one after at 71px, up and down alike, read 1px at a time (CAP-Z3WALK.json). 10px no, 30px yes, 72px passes two.

hold.ghost: the row follows the pointer in y, over everything, read from the shot: over white rgb(232, 241, 254), over the page color rgb(201, 178, 249), so about rgb(215, 230, 253) at .57, with a soft shadow. It does not follow in x, and it starts following y at 10px (CAP-Z3WALK.json)
hold.slot: where it would land: a blue row rgb(72, 148, 255) with no content
hold.panel: stays put, the layers order in the section does not need a reload
hold.drag: a drag starts at 9px in x or y (CAP-Z3WALK.json)
hold.blocks: the blocks' z do not change while held (CAP-Z3WALK.json)

undo: one undo per drop, back to Save disabled after one drop

panel.box: 240 by 500, 11px under the Layers button: 22,279 with the button at 224 to 268, and 22,132 with it at 77 to 121

rowLook.row: 218 by 44, 11px in from the panel, 3px apart, rgb(249, 249, 249), radius 6
rowLook.icon: 22 by 22, 17px from the row's left, 11px from its top
rowLook.name: starts 50px from the row's left, 14px, weight 400, rgb(14, 14, 14), 22px tall
rowLook.shape: a filled square, also when the shape itself is white
rowLook.measuredOn: new page Gestures Probe, nothing saved
rowLook.title: 16px, weight 500, 22 from the panel's left, 17 from its top, 20 tall; the first row starts 54 from the panel's top
rowLook.names: a text block's row is its text, cut short, read on the demo page without changing it: as in ours
